testcase.name: Scenario: Switch ribbon tabs while the direct panel list is open: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-panel-visibility-source/features/application/ribbon-panel-visibility/ribbon-panel-visibility.feature:216:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Switch ribbon tabs while the direct panel list is open ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is open and active ✔ And the expanded 3D Model ribbon is docked at the top ✔ And Modify is visible and Parameters is hidden ✔ When the user opens the ribbon panel selector ✔ Then the panel list shows Modify checked and Parameters unchecked ✔ When the user selects the View ribbon tab ✔ Then the panel list closes ✔ And the View ribbon is displayed ✔ When the user returns to the 3D Model ribbon tab ✔ Then the panel list remains closed ✔ And Modify remains visible and Parameters remains hidden
